moments.title: Autumn Equinox Approaches
moments.blurb: The Autumn Equinox, marking the official start of astronomical autumn and equal day and night, arrives on Wednesday, September 23rd in the UK.

angles.name: General Acknowledge
angles.copy: That's it for summer sunshine! The Autumn Equinox is just a few days away on Wednesday, officially ushering in the new season. Get ready for cosy nights! 🍂

angles.name: Stonehenge Hook
angles.copy: Fancy seeing the sunrise at Stonehenge on the Autumn Equinox? English Heritage is offering free access on Wednesday morning. Worth the early start! 🌅

angles.name: Harvest Moon
angles.copy: The Autumn Equinox isn't just about longer nights, it also brings the Harvest Moon on September 26th this year. Keep an eye out for it! 🌕

angles.name: Season Opener Hype
